vars.H1: Merge and shrink PDFs without uploading them
vars.LEDE: Your files stay on your device. pdf.lol does the work inside this browser tab, so there's no upload, no account and no watermark.

pages.title: Compress a PDF without uploading it · pdf.lol
pages.description: Shrink a PDF's photos and scans right in your browser. The file never leaves your device. No signup, no watermark, no daily limit.

vars.H1: Make a PDF smaller without uploading it
vars.LEDE: pdf.lol shrinks the photos and scans inside your PDF, right in this browser tab. Text stays sharp and the file never leaves your device.

pages.title: Sign a PDF for free, no upload · pdf.lol
pages.description: Draw or type your signature and place it on a PDF, right in your browser. No account, no upload, no watermark.

vars.H1: Sign a PDF without uploading it
vars.LEDE: Draw or type your signature, drag it where it goes, and download. The PDF and your signature never leave this device.

pages.title: Split a PDF or pull out pages, no upload · pdf.lol
pages.description: Pick pages or ranges and save them as separate PDFs, right in your browser. Your file never leaves your device.

vars.H1: Split a PDF without uploading it
vars.LEDE: Pull out the pages you need, or break a PDF into pieces. Everything happens in this browser tab.

pages.title: PDF to JPG: turn pages into images, no upload · pdf.lol
pages.description: Save every page of a PDF as a JPG or PNG image, right in your browser. Pick the quality, download one page or a ZIP of all of them.

vars.H1: Turn PDF pages into JPG images
vars.LEDE: Each page becomes its own image, made in this browser tab. Your PDF is never uploaded.

pages.title: JPG to PDF: combine images into one PDF, no upload · pdf.lol
pages.description: Turn JPG, PNG or WebP images into a single PDF, right in your browser. Reorder them, pick a page size, and download. No upload.

vars.LEDE: Drop in photos or scans, put them in order, and get a single PDF. Nothing gets uploaded.
